feed.title: CR Coffee Shop News
feed.subtitle: Stories from CR Coffee Shop in New Orleans: new blends, events, and what is happening at the shops.

entry.title: Marielle Songy Wrote the Book on New Orleans Coffee. Then She Came By for a Cup.
entry.summary: Kevin sits down with Marielle Songy, author of Coffee Culture New Orleans (LSU Press), the book that calls him one of the city's most knowledgeable coffee experts.

entry.title: The Most Decadent Drink We Make Is Also the Coldest
entry.summary: How CR Coffee builds the Chocolate Covered Espresso Bean frozen: cold brew, frozen coffee base, dark cocoa, and espresso grounds blended in and on top.

entry.title: Hey, I Got the Study Spot.
entry.summary: Back to school: CR Coffee on Magazine Street is about ten minutes from Tulane and Loyola, with a shaded side patio, seats in the AC, and fast Wi-Fi.

entry.title: It's Just a Ham and Cheese Croissant. Except for One Thing.
entry.summary: The ham and cheese croissant at CR Coffee is the lunch you grab when there isn't time for lunch. What makes it ours: a local Cajun seasoning we won't name.

entry.title: The Bayou Beast Made the News
entry.summary: Axios New Orleans told the story of the Bayou Beast, our pandan iced latte: where he came from, how he took over the menu, and the Muses shoe he inspired.

entry.title: The Bayou Beast Is Back
entry.summary: The Bayou Beast is back at all three CR Coffee shops: a pandan iced latte topped with warm fall spices, here for a limited time until Halloween.

entry.title: Make Our Cold Brew at Home This Summer
entry.summary: The CR Coffee Cold Brew Kit brings our cold brew home: a 32 ounce MiiR insulated bottle, a stainless steel filter, and a bag of St. Roch Blend for $75.95.

entry.title: “It Tastes Like Morning”: Coffee With Philip, Age Seven
entry.summary: Kevin has coffee with his seven-year-old son Philip, who reviews the Streetcar Blend they brew at home: it tastes like morning, and a little milk helps.

entry.title: CR Coffee in the Fox 8 Kitchen: Four Rules for Better Coffee at Home
entry.summary: Kevin took CR Coffee's home brewing playbook to the Fox 8 Kitchen: fresh roasted coffee, a burr grinder, hot water, and the Clever Coffee Dripper.

entry.title: Black Coffee, Iced Tea, Red Wine. In That Order.
entry.summary: Kevin's sleeper product, the Lagniappe Iced Tea blend: deep amber color, real body, always brewing at every CR Coffee shop and many Coast Roast accounts.

entry.title: Allow Me to Reintroduce Myself: Meet Kevin
entry.summary: Meet Kevin Pedeaux, founder of CR Coffee Shop: the guy in our videos on Coast Roast, roasting in Long Beach, Mississippi, and thick New Orleans coffee.

entry.title: CR Coffee on WWL: The Changing Face of Magazine Street
entry.summary: Kevin joined WWL Louisiana to talk about Magazine Street's changing landscape as local staples Coquette and Feet First close and national brands move in.

entry.title: A Timor Single Origin, And Why It's Not Sumatra This Year
entry.summary: CR Coffee's Indonesian slot is a Timor single origin this year, not Sumatra: Hybrido de Timor from Cooperativa Cafe Timor. Earthy, cocoa-forward, low acid.

entry.title: CR Coffee to Serve Affogatos at Saturday's Magazine Street Champagne Stroll
entry.summary: CR Coffee Shop serves affogatos at Magazine Street during the Champagne Stroll on Saturday, May 9, 2026: espresso over vanilla ice cream, until 9 p.m.

entry.title: Strawberry Chai: A Louisiana Summer in a Cup
entry.summary: CR Coffee's limited time Strawberry Chai: house made chai, fresh strawberry puree, cold foam, and cinnamon, created by barista Emma Lincoln. Through July.

entry.title: A CR Coffee Mother's Day Gift Guide
entry.summary: Kevin's 2026 Mother's Day gift guide: Streetcar Blend, St. Roch Blend, Venezuelan single origin, Cold Brew Blend, a Baratza grinder, and a porch seat.

entry.title: Your Coffee Has Been Paying Off: How CR Coffee Rewards Works
entry.summary: How CR Coffee Rewards works: earn a Bean for every dollar, unlock Shot Tiers, and redeem Beans for free drinks and free bags of coffee.

entry.title: Venezuelan Coffee Is Back at CR Coffee
entry.summary: Venezuelan coffee is back at CR Coffee for the first time in twenty years: 100% Arabica from the Sanare region, roasted on antique drums, in 12 oz bags.

entry.title: Two Decades in New Orleans Coffee
entry.summary: Kevin Pedeaux on two decades in New Orleans coffee: wholesale blends in 2004, co-founding Coast Roast in 2009, and opening CR Coffee Shop across the city.

entry.title: Cherry Blossom Matcha Hits the Spring Menu
entry.summary: CR Coffee's spring drink pairs hand-whisked matcha with cherry blossom powder from Japan. At all four New Orleans locations through spring 2026.

entry.title: The Crescent Room: Your Private New Orleans Workspace
entry.summary: The Crescent Room at CR Coffee Shop is open for bookings: a private, quiet workspace inside a shotgun house off Magazine Street. Bottomless coffee.

entry.title: Spring Vibes: Porch & Patio Season Is Here
entry.summary: Spring is here and the porch and patio at CR Coffee Shop on Magazine Street are officially open for the season. Come for the coffee, stay for the vibes.

entry.title: Water Woes: How Boil Advisories Hit New Orleans Small Businesses
entry.summary: WDSU on boil water advisories and New Orleans businesses: Kevin Pedeaux on how CR Coffee handles water main breaks and what they cost a small business.

entry.title: CR Coffee in The Wall Street Journal
entry.summary: CR Coffee was featured in The Wall Street Journal discussing rising coffee prices, tariffs, and the impact on specialty roasters.

entry.title: Behind the Cup: How We Choose Our Coffee
entry.summary: Inside a CR Coffee cupping session: how Kevin evaluates green coffee samples, picks out flavor profiles, and builds the blends you drink at the shop.
